title: Feed the Knight
setup: The king on h8 is buried behind its own pawns, and Black's knight on e7 is the only black piece that reaches g8.
hint: The corner is already a cage. What would you give to have g8 occupied by a black piece?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qg8+}} cannot be taken by the king, because your knight on h6 covers g8 — so {{Nxg8}} is the only move. The last flight square is blocked by Black's own knight, and {{Nf7#}} is smothered mate.
